question: If the Vercel author-access gate cannot be resolved promptly, may this dependency refresh merge using the submitted exact-head local build and browser proof without successful previews for both hosted projects?
rationale: The diff does not demonstrate a dependency defect, but recent history shows that this package surface can affect hosted availability and only a repository owner can accept the residual environment-specific proof gap.

options.title: Require both previews
options.body: Resolve commit-author access and require successful exact-head previews for both Vercel projects before merge.

options.title: Accept equivalent hosted proof
options.body: Allow merge only after an owner reviews and records equivalent exact-head hosted-build evidence covering both projects.

options.title: Defer the refresh
options.body: Pause or close the maintenance PR if neither preview authorization nor equivalent deployment evidence is available.

recommendation.title: Require both previews
recommendation.body: Resolve commit-author access and require successful exact-head previews for both Vercel projects before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged history on the dependency files and prior refresh, making him the best available owner for the deployment-proof threshold.
